_note: What produced the Juvenile and set-piece models on 2026-09-29 (see docs/ASSETS.md). Redo one with: python tools/tripo.py run tools/tripo_jobs.json --only Name --redo Name. jobs.name: HollowStump
jobs.prompt: A giant hollow tree stump, a fantasy game world prop: thick gnarled bark walls with a jagged broken rim, a tall arched opening in one side big enough to walk through, thick roots splayed out gripping the ground, patches of green moss on the rim and a few small glowing teal mushrooms. Stylized semi-realistic, faceted low-poly shapes with smooth shading and solid color regions, earthy browns and moss greens. Single object standing upright, no ground plane.
